paper.title: Geoneutrinos (and reactor neutrinos) do not visibly decay

content: Every lower limit on the neutrino lifetime-to-mass ratio, tau_i/m_i, that the paper reports: each decay channel, each experiment and combination, each Earth model, at 90% and 95% C.L., from data and expected.

how_to_read.lower_limit_s_per_eV: The limits, in s/eV, keyed as [channel][lifetime][fit][Earth model][C.L.][observed or expected]. null where that fit sets no limit.
how_to_read.channel: The decay channel; see 'channels'. A chain, in which the daughter of the first decay decays in turn, limits the lifetimes of both of its parents.
how_to_read.lifetime: tau1_over_m1, tau2_over_m2 or tau3_over_m3: the lifetime-to-mass ratio limited, of nu_1, nu_2 or nu_3.
how_to_read.fit: The experiment or the combination of experiments fitted; see 'fits'.
how_to_read.Earth model: The class of bulk-silicate-Earth model, which fixes the Earth's radiogenic power, or the power left free between 9.4 and 39.6 TW; see 'earth_models'.
90 or 95, the confidence level of the one-sided lower limit.
how_to_read.observed: The limit from the experiments' data.
how_to_read.expected: The limit from the Asimov data set, in which every bin holds its expected number of events without decay.
how_to_read.statistics: Frequentist limits from the profile likelihood ratio: at each trial lifetime, every other parameter is fitted. The limit is where the test statistic reaches 1.64 (90% C.L.) or 2.71 (95% C.L.); the limits on tau3_over_m3 are read at thresholds calibrated with simulated experiments instead.

fits.combined_all: Borexino, KamLAND, SNO+, and JUNO combined

earth_models.cosmochemical: Cosmochemical bulk-silicate-Earth model, radiogenic power 9.4 TW
earth_models.geochemical: Geochemical bulk-silicate-Earth model, radiogenic power 16.5 TW
earth_models.geodynamical: Geodynamical bulk-silicate-Earth model, radiogenic power 28.8 TW
earth_models.free_radiogenic_power: Radiogenic power free between 9.4 and 39.6 TW
